description: Home and away kits of real football clubs as retro_roster_patcher KitSpec dicts (shirt, secondary, pattern, shorts, socks, sleeves; colours #rrggbb). Look a club up by espn_id (ESPN's soccer team id) or, for one without, by name or one of its names. Clubs: the footballdatabase.com world ranking's top 100 (ranking) plus every Brasileirao Serie A 2026 club (ranking null).
source: Kit colours and patterns read from each club's English Wikipedia infobox kit fields (2026-27 season), then reviewed by eye against Wikipedia's kit drawings.
